svg.title: Compare Five Channel and Service Offers
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-channel-contribution-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Five Channel and Service Offers; subtitle: Illustrative contribution yields after vendor and direct delivery costs.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Bars show contribution as a percentage of each offer's gross billings, before shared staffing and overhead; they are not net margins or vendor-published discounts. Each example uses $100,000 gross billings. These independent examples are not a weighted portfolio forecast.; caption: Canonical annual outcomes remain Conservative: $300,000 at 8% equals $24,000; Base: $1,400,000 at 14.0% equals $196,000; Scaled: $2,500,000 at 20% equals $500,000. The first two use 2 FT + 3 C; Scaled uses 3 FT + 4 C.; stages: label: CSP seat renewals; value: 18% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 18.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $82,000 vendor and direct support costs leaves $18,000. Verify renewal pricing, cancellation windows, and responsibility for unpaid seats.; label: CPPO license offers; value: 24% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 24.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $76,000 vendor, marketplace, and direct execution costs leaves $24,000. Confirm the selling authorization and actual settlement calendar.; label: Security software deployments; value: 30% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $70,000 license and deployment costs leaves $30,000. Price integrations explicitly and separate customer acceptance from open-ended remediation.; label: Data-platform migrations; value: 35% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 35.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $65,000 vendor and migration costs leaves $35,000. Meter migration effort and exclude customer infrastructure consumption outside the contract.; label: Workflow application implementations; value: 42% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 42.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $58,000 license and delivery costs leaves $42,000. Limit custom connectors, document acceptance tests, and charge separately for scope changes.

rect.title: label: CSP seat renewals; value: 18% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 18.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $82,000 vendor and direct support costs leaves $18,000. Verify renewal pricing, cancellation windows, and responsibility for unpaid seats.

label: CPPO license offers; value: 24% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 24.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $76,000 vendor, marketplace, and direct execution costs leaves $24,000. Confirm the selling authorization and actual settlement calendar.

label: Security software deployments; value: 30% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $70,000 license and deployment costs leaves $30,000. Price integrations explicitly and separate customer acceptance from open-ended remediation.

label: Data-platform migrations; value: 35% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 35.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $65,000 vendor and migration costs leaves $35,000. Meter migration effort and exclude customer infrastructure consumption outside the contract.

label: Workflow application implementations; value: 42% contribution after directly attributable costs; numeric value: 42.0; detail: $100,000 gross billings less $58,000 license and delivery costs leaves $42,000. Limit custom connectors, document acceptance tests, and charge separately for scope changes.
